caption:
अरे भाइयो, पंकज त्रिपाठी के संघर्ष की कहानी सुनकर उड़ जाएंगे होश! 🤯

हाल ही में पंकज त्रिपाठी Netflix के शो The Great Indian Kapil Show में नजर आए जहाँ उन्होंने अपनी जिंदगी के कई दिलचस्प राज खोले। 📺

पंकज ने बताया कि वह स्टूडेंट लीडर बनना चाहते थे, लेकिन पुलिस की इतनी मार पड़ी कि उन्होंने इरादा बदल दिया। इसके अलावा उन्होंने एक होटल में दो साल तक प्याज और आलू छीले, जिसके बाद उन्हें अहसास हुआ कि उनकी तकदीर कुछ और ही है। 🥔

OTT प्लेटफॉर्म्स के बारे में बात करते हुए उन्होंने माना कि OTT ने हम जैसे आम परिवारों से आने वाले आउटसाइडर्स को नाम कमाने और अपनी जगह बनाने का मौका दिया है। 🌟

National School of Drama से 2004 में पास आउट होने के बाद वह मुंबई आए, जहाँ उन्होंने 2004 में फिल्म Run से डेब्यू किया और 2012 में Gangs of Wasseypur से उन्हें बड़ा ब्रेक मिला। 🎬

अब उनकी आने वाली फिल्म Parvarik ManuRanjan SonyLIV पर 13 नवंबर को रिलीज़ होने के लिए तैयार है, जिसमें उनके साथ अदिति राव हैदरी भी हैं। 🎥

क्या आपने कभी आलू-प्याज छीलते हुए अपनी तकदीर बदलने के बारे में सोचा है? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Pankaj Tripathi recalls peeling onions and potatoes at hotel for 2 years before becoming an actor
ctx.summary: Pankaj Tripathi revealed on The Great Indian Kapil Show that he once hoped to become a student leader, but changed course after being beaten by police.
ctx.text:
Bollywood actor Pankaj Tripathi recently appeared on Kapil Sharma 's Netflix show, The Great Indian Kapil Show , along with Vikas Divyakirti and Zakir Khan. During the show, Pankaj spoke about his journey and the choices that shaped his career. He also made an interesting revelation about what he wanted to pursue before becoming an actor.
When an audience member revealed that he was confused about his career, Kapil asked Pankaj if he had ever experienced similar uncertainty before getting into acting. The actor then revealed, "Even I wanted to be a student leader, but the police beat me so badly, that day I changed my mind because I realised getting beaten up is involved in it. I even worked at a hotel for 2 years, while peeling onions and potatoes, I realised my desitny is something else and not this."
When Navjot Singh Sidhu asked if he credited the OTT space for helping him grow, Pankaj said, "I agree that OTT helped outsiders make a name for themselves. We all belong to ordinary families, but in this democratic space we got opportunities and worked hard to earn our places. This possibility exists for every kid in India, and of course new mediums emerge, so new opportunities open up."
After graduating from the National School of Drama in 2004, Pankaj Tripathi moved to Mumbai to pursue acting. He made his film debut with a small role in Run in 2004, followed by appearances in films such as Omkara, Apaharan and Agneepath.
His breakthrough came in 2012 with Anurag Kashyap's Gangs of Wasseypur, in which he played Sultan Qureshi. The performance brought him wider recognition and opened doors to projects such as Fukrey, Masaan, Bareilly Ki Barfi and Newton. He received a National Film Award Special Mention for his performance as Atma Singh in Newton.
The actor's popularity grew further with the arrival of OTT platforms. His portrayal of Kaleen Bhaiya in Mirzapur (2018) became a turning point, earning him immense popularity and making the character a household name. He then went on to win audiences over as lawyer Madhav Mishra in Criminal Justice.
The actor is now awaiting the release of his upcoming film, Parvarik ManuRanjan. Directed by Varun V Sharma, the film also stars Aditi Rao Hydari in the lead role, alongside Mukesh Tiwari, Vijayant Kohli, Karan Chanana and Bijendra Kala in supporting roles. It is scheduled to premiere on SonyLIV on November 13.
